item.title: dotnet: Analyze MSBuild Binary Logs with Copilot in VS Code
item.description:
Microsoft introduced the MSBuild Binlog Analyzer for VS Code, a Copilot-powered tool for reading MSBuild binary logs, explaining build failures, suggesting fixes, comparing builds, and identifying regressions. It uses the Microsoft.AITools.BinlogMcp MCP server.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: AI-Powered MSBuild Investigation with the Microsoft Binlog MCP Server
item.description:
Microsoft introduced the Binlog MCP Server for investigating MSBuild build failures and performance issues with AI. It provides 15 specialized tools for analyzing MSBuild binary logs through an AI assistant.

  • Source: .NET
